notes.title: Portraits Updating
notes.notes:
Since the release of the demo, many friends have expressed concerns about the inconsistent style of vertical painting. Due to the large number of characters, it is difficult to redo them all in a short period of time.

During this period, some stylistic adjustments have been made to the existing vertical paintings to make their styles as consistent as possible. Priority has been given to the protagonist group, and major adjustments have been made to all four female protagonists. Other major teammates, as well as the main playing NPCs, have also undergone some adjustments.

Have fun!

notes.title: Text Updating
notes.notes:
According to player feedback, They are not accustomed to using two languages simultaneously, so I removed the English text to make the interface simpler and easier to read.

It includes UI interface, storyline dialogue, and other explanatory descriptions.

There are numerous scenes and a large amount of text, which inevitably leads to omissions. If there are any omissions or other bugs caused as a result, please feel free to provide feedback. QQ group: 704550905.

notes.title: See You In October
notes.notes:
You can experience all gameplay in demo. Only the plot and related data are incomplete.

Tiaohe data is opened and selecting this character data as the player will greatly reduce the difficulty of the game. This data is only available in Demo. In formal version, it needs to be unlocked through achievements.
If you want to experience data and balance normally, please select the initial data of Wood or Fire. Other data will be opened in the formal version.
When playing normally, it is initially recommended to choose simple mode (this mode cannot get achievements); After understanding the game, choose normal mode. Difficult and extremely difficult modes will be added in the formal version.

Only 4 sects are opened in demo.

Except for the initial quests, others will not be displayed in the UI panel until triggered.
